bio_en: Hambardzum Melik-Sargsian, a native of Gharadagh, worked for many years in responsible posts for the Tumanian brothers. Inspired by the enthusiasm of the time, he took an active part in the Khanasor expedition of 1897 and later in Yeprem's undertakings in Persia. His later public and educational work was mainly in the Gilan region, especially Pahlavi. He died suddenly in Rasht on 31 March 1934 at the age of 70.
